title: Mitchell confessed blue orbs to 'the Spaceman'

tellings.quote: quotes an anonymous source which who he calls the spaceman who was apparently very close personal friends with Ed Mitchell. And he says Ed Mitchell confessed to him that yeah, we saw these blue orb like lights following us or you know from the lunar surface

plain: A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani, on Jesse Michels' podcast, points to a book called In Plain Sight by journalist Ross Coulthart. He says the book quotes an anonymous close friend of astronaut Edgar Mitchell, nicknamed the Spaceman, who says Mitchell confessed that on the 1971 Apollo 14 moon mission the crew saw blue, orb-like lights following them or seen from the moon's surface. If true, it would mean astronauts met something unexplained on the moon.
